    # we use a modified Bellman-Ford for efficiency and correctness.

    dist = [float('inf')] * n
    dist[s] = 0

    queue = deque()
    queue.append(s)

    # Keep track of nodes that have been relaxed
    in_queue = [False] * n
    in_queue[s] = True

        in_queue[u] = False

            if dist[v] > dist[u] + w:
                dist[v] = dist[u] + w
                if not in_queue[v]:
